feeds.title: Jennifer Chronicles Blog » Gen X
feeds.description: Hello, my name is Jennifer, I'm an American mother and writer. My blog is for and about my generation -- Generation X. The years for Generation X are 1961 to 1981. We're sandwiched between Baby Boomers and Generation Y. Generation X Blog featuring posts on faith, family, culture and career. Insights and commentary on generations.

feeds.title: Technomadia Blog
feeds.description: Chris Dunphy & Cherie Ve Ard are full time Gen-X travelers who utilize technology to enable their nomadism.

feeds.title: Gen X Traveler Blog
feeds.description: GenXTraveler is a travel site written for Generation X by a Gen Xer. If you love travel but feel like everything on the internet is written for the millenials or the baby boomer bunch then Gen X Traveler is for you.

feeds.title: Cyndi Spivey
feeds.description: I'm Cyndi and I share tips on fashion, make-up, and beauty, as well as reminders that true beauty begins on the inside. This site is a destination for women over 40 looking for everyday style and beauty advice.

feeds.title: 40+Style
feeds.description: Discover how to dress after 40, find fashion over 40 inspiration, get the best beauty tips and disover how to make life after fun and rewarding!

feeds.title: Lindsey Pollak's Blog
feeds.description: Millennial and Multigenerational Workplace Expert Lindsey Pollak's blog covers the future of work topics such as navigating generational differences at work, leadership, and career advice. Lindsey Pollak is the leading expert on the millennial generation and today's multigenerational workplace. Often called a 'translator,' she advises both young professionals looking to succeed in today's work environment and the organizations that want to recruit, retain and engage them.

feeds.title: Retire by 40
feeds.description: Posts on early retirement, frugal lifestyle, making money, real estate and stocks. Joe Udo wants to change the way you think about retirement. Retire by 40 is a place to share his aspiration for Financial Independence.

feeds.title: Beauty4Free2U
feeds.description: Hey you! So happy you are here in my little beauty corner! I´m an over 40 beauty lover and I am sharing here beauty tips - especially for women over 40- on how to look young and fresh and other inspirational things! I hope you stick around!

feeds.title: Gen X Watch
feeds.description: Gen X Watch is a blog by Pat Green, a journalist, photographer, and creative storyteller. It explores Gen X identity, nostalgia, current cultural tensions, and societal commentary through essays rooted in both personal and generational experiences.

feeds.title: MyGenXerLife
feeds.description: This is a Gen X music blog that explores life through the lens of the music of my youth.

feeds.title: Gen X and Proud of It
feeds.description: Gen X and Proud of It presents personal essays, commentary, and occasional book reviews, centering on identity, resilience, and the Gen X experience. It's a solo-written space that reflects on professional life, generational values, and cultural pride.

feeds.title: Diary of a Gen-X Traveler
feeds.description: Diary of a Gen‑X Traveler is a vivid, experience-based travel blog that speaks directly to Gen‑X readers offering heartfelt stories, practical advice, and cultural depth, all through the lens of someone living and loving midlife exploration.

feeds.title: Gen X Abroad Blog
feeds.description: Lifestyles for Gen X: Smart money moves, work-life balance, and health hacks for the in-between generation. Discover insights for thriving in their prime years!

feeds.title: Gen X Gen Z Blog
feeds.description: The latest from David and Angelica about Generation X and Generation Z - and the similarities and differences in marketing to these groups.

feeds.title: Jenny Magazine
feeds.description: Jenny is a website for women who read. Sassy was our feminist teenage touchstone: It spoke to us about real things like we were real people. Jenny is that for Gen X and elder Millennial women who don't see themselves reflected in online media today. They cover style & beauty, relationships, health & wellness, and culture & entertainment.

feeds.title: GenXGrownUp
feeds.description: Tech, toys, media, games, & pop culture from today and yesterday through the eyes of Generation X.

feeds.title: The Gen X Files
feeds.description: The Gen-X Files is written by Dave Sohigian and is focused on generational issues, especially those relating to the 13th Generation, born 1961-1980. Much of the research for this site is drawn from the works of Neil Howe and William Strauss of Lifecourses.

feeds.title: GenX Gets OLD
feeds.description: Lifestyles of the middle aged, middle incomed, middle generation genXers.

feeds.title: Gen X Girls Grow Up
feeds.description: Generation X girls have grown up. What shaped us, and shapes us now? For all the challenges we had to overcome, and all the things we were called - The Middle Child, Slackers, Latchkey Kids - I'd say we're doing alright!

feeds.title: Midlife Rambler Blog
feeds.description: Midlife Rambler is for all the women who sometimes feel like the oldest person ever and sometimes feel they still haven't grown up. We talk about life after the kids are left and life after they come back. We talk about books we've read and want to read and meals we want to read. We talk about life and we like to ramble.

feeds.title: Gen X Nerd
feeds.description: Gen X Nerd, run by Trevor, captures the authentic voice of a Gen X creator who's been doing nerdy stuff since 1978. The blog is an eclectic mix of personal updates, comic book collecting, DIY tech builds, and handcrafted creations.

feeds.title: Fabulous After 40
feeds.description: Fabulous after 40 provides beauty and fashion style for women over 40. Deborah Boland is a fashion style expert and image consultant who gives advice on topics like dresses for women over 40, what to wear with leggings and clothes for women over 40.
